node.title: Re^5: A lexical lib pragma?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I do want it to affect 'use' too, as well as require/do.

In that case I think you'll have to use [mod://B::Hooks::EndOfScope]. For dynamic scoping at runtime, I imagine Filter::Inject could be used to inject a piece of code that basically makes a [doc://local] change to [doc://@INC]. For either compile or runtime, if you want it to be lexically scoped, I still can't think of a better way than an [doc://@INC] hook and [doc://%^H]. Although I also still can't imagine a use case for use with a lexically scoped [doc://@INC] :-/
